title: Anti Beds
description: This mod allowed you to disable accedentaly right clicking a bed, the hotkey can be changed in the minecraft hotkey menu.
body:
AntiBed is a mod primarely designed for 2B2T, but can be used on any server. This is my first public mod so any bugs reports will be apreciated. [Discord](https://discord.gg/UgmKEtvrXC).

How to use the mod: if you go into your mincraft menu and press options, controls and then keybinds. There you can find the tab AntiBeds you need to set a keybind for Toggle Antibeds. Then if you press that keybind you will no longer be able to accedentaly right click beds untill you press the keybind again.

Mod made by SquidBoyIsBack
